name: Sarkhan Vol
description: A dragon-worshipping planeswalker native to Tarkir, a Mardu warrior whose spark ignited when a dragon spirit's spell unleashed a fire dragon.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol, mind unraveling, returns to Tarkir in disgrace and begins to hear a voice.
timeline.quote: I return in disgrace because no other plane will have me.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recalls Bolas sending him to the Eye of Ugin to watch, and being left blinded and sleeping.
timeline.quote: Bolas sent me to the Eye. He told me to wait.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Bolas treated him as a mere pawn and dismissed him as a dragon's toy.
timeline.quote: I am dismissed, a dragon's toy, tossed aside and useless.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan grows up among the Mardu Horde as a feared battle mage and wing leader, scorching clans of the hinterlands.
timeline.quote: Talent with battle magic, and natural ferocity, made me feared among the Horde.

timeline.summary: Flashback: sick of endless blood, Sarkhan leaves his clan for the Qal Sisma Mountains, where a figure takes his shape and he joins the whisperers' chant of dragons.
timeline.quote: They remembered the old ones.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan returns and the hordechief Zurgo demands his obedience, sending him against the Sultai.
timeline.quote: The Helmsmasher grudgingly sent me forth with a wing of riders to challenge the Sultai

timeline.summary: Flashback: in a stalemated battle Sarkhan kills the Sultai sorcerer, finds a quiet point, hears an ancient voice and a fire dragon bursts from his soul, burning everything.
timeline.quote: From my soul, a being of pure fire burst into the sky.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan is cast to an alien desert world and spends years watching and following dragons, seeking a king to honor.
timeline.quote: I spent the next years watching and following, learning all I could about the dragons.

timeline.summary: Flashback: on Jund Sarkhan finds the dragons magnificent but unworthy and fights alongside tribes hunting Malactoth.
timeline.quote: Old Malactoth— he had been a true challenge.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recalls the name Ugin as the dragon he should have heeded, and hears a voice telling him to find the doorway.
timeline.quote: The world remembers what its people have forgotten.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to seek the whisperers of the mountaintops again to find the door and make Tarkir strong again.
timeline.quote: I will make us strong again.

timeline.summary: A messenger reveals the Temur attacked because a man calling himself Sarkhan turned into a dragon in Temur forests and the Temur mistook him for the new Mardu khan.
timeline.quote: He…they say he turned into a dragon. And breathed fire on them, took off, and flew farther into Temur territory.

timeline.summary: Zurgo declares Vol must die, and Varuk warns he is too dangerous, recalling Vol's desertion and dragonfire against the Mardu army.
timeline.quote: I was there when he turned into a great flying beast of flame and roasted your army with his breath.

timeline.summary: Left alone, Zurgo resolves to kill Vol, refusing to wipe Batar's blood from his blade until it mixes with Vol's.
timeline.quote: He would not clean it until it had mixed with Vol's.

timeline.summary: Zurgo kills a dying Temur woman after learning Vol went toward the Spirit Dragon's tomb, then rides there alone.
timeline.quote: He plunged his sword into the woman's throat and she stopped moving.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges in darkness on a snowy Temur tundra after passing through the flaming gate, with the gate gone and Ugin's voice silent.
timeline.quote: But now he was standing still in the darkness in the middle of a vast, snowy Temur tundra.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan grieves that Narset died and cries out to Ugin, realizing the voice in his head is gone.
timeline.quote: The ceaseless whispering, the constant flow of Ugin's words in his head—the voice was gone!

timeline.summary: Sarkhan falls to his knees, begging Ugin to speak, then laughs hysterically at the irony of wanting the whispers back.
timeline.quote: You can't be silent now!

timeline.summary: A storm of luminous clouds breaks over the tundra and dragons emerge from the tempest, to Sarkhan's amazement.
timeline.quote: A dragon!

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees antlered dragons on Tarkir and realizes that the gate has taken him to Tarkir's past, as Narset's scrolls foretold.
timeline.quote: And it had led him to the past. It had led him here.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan follows the fledglings' flight across the tundra, believing this to be his path of healing for his plane.
timeline.quote: This was his path, the path that Ugin had set him on, the path of healing for his plane.

timeline.summary: A great dominant dragon arrives and leads the fledglings in formation to hunt.
timeline.quote: She had come to lead them. Now they would hunt.

timeline.summary: The dragons raid a human encampment in a basin while Sarkhan watches in awe.
timeline.quote: The brood descended like a barrage of flaming arrows.

timeline.summary: A fledgling's gaze welcomes Sarkhan to its brood and he begins to transform into a dragon.
timeline.quote: His transformation began without a conscious thought, without his permission

timeline.summary: A human warrior woman with a glowing red claw and her sabertooth kill two fledglings, interrupting Sarkhan's transformation.
timeline.quote: As the fallen dragon turned on her, she cut through its face from eye to jaw.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, enraged, is about to attack the warrior but is stopped by a calm memory of how dragons brought balance, and his anger turns to awe at her.
timeline.quote: She was a survivor—no, a conqueror!—following a battle with dragons.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to make sure dragons are waiting for Narset when she lives again on Tarkir, believing the past is gone and this is a new Tarkir.
timeline.quote: when Narset lived again on Tarkir, there would be dragons waiting for her.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan embraces the new beginning, calling it his Tarkir.
timeline.quote: This was a new beginning, a new Tarkir—his Tarkir.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas and Ugin, long-time rivals, finally clash in the sky above Tarkir, and Sarkhan arrives to watch.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas and Ugin—two of the most powerful Planeswalkers the Multiverse has ever known—finally clashed in the sky above Tarkir.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the whispers in his head were Ugin's plea leading him across time, and that his choice will reforge Tarkir's fate.
timeline.quote: they were a plea from Ugin that had led Sarkhan across time to this place and this moment.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, arrived in Tarkir's past, follows the woman with the dragon-claw staff up a mountain by her trail of marks.
timeline.quote: gouged two sweeping curves into it with the clawed staff she carried.

timeline.summary: Yasova's sabertooth tackles Sarkhan from behind and pins him in the snow.
timeline.quote: Something slammed into him from behind, huge and living and warm.

timeline.summary: Yasova questions Sarkhan, who says he follows the whispers of Ugin and thinks she may be his spirit guide.
timeline.quote: I seek the great dragon Ugin.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan gives his name; she greets him mockingly as 'khan of khans,' and he declines to claim dominion, bowing and flattering her as he once did Bolas.
timeline.quote: Yasova Dragonclaw of the Temur pays her respects to you, O khan of khans, and bids you welcome to her lands.

timeline.summary: Yasova threatens to kill Sarkhan unless he gives a reason to be spared; he kneels and offers to serve her.
timeline.quote: Give me a reason to spare you, Vol, or I'll kill you and be on my way.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan tells Yasova that in his homeland there are no dragons or dragon tempests, only bones, and that Ugin is long dead.
timeline.quote: Not in all of Tarkir," he said. "Only bones.

timeline.summary: Yasova confirms that she believes the dragons fall if Ugin dies, and Sarkhan realizes a storm guided him to her.
timeline.quote: If Ugin dies, the storms cease. The dragons fall.

timeline.summary: Yasova furiously rejects Sarkhan's claim that her people are better than the weak khans of his time, saying she has seen a paradise with no dragons.
timeline.quote: But I've seen the unwritten myself, seen a world with no dragons. And it was paradise.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the dragon in her vision was Bolas, already on Tarkir in the past.
timeline.quote: Bolas was already here!

timeline.summary: Sarkhan transforms into a dragon, breathes fire to push Yasova aside rather than fight, and flies off to protect Ugin.
timeline.quote: With a kick from his powerful legs, Sarkhan Vol launched himself into the sky.

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that the sar-khan encased Ugin in a stone cocoon after she healed him, causing the tempests to return fourfold.
timeline.quote: He encased Ugin in a great stone cocoon inscribed with draconic runes.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan is pulled back through time and finds himself before the weathered hedron cocoon, evidence that many years have passed.
timeline.quote: He was standing before the hedron cocoon, exactly where he had been a mere moment before

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees a herd of dragons overhead and understands that the dragons survived, then transforms and joins them.
timeline.quote: And in his dragon form, Sarkhan Vol took to the sky.

timeline.summary: The herd roars with Sarkhan, and he sees changed land with five broods and new dragons from a tempest.
timeline.quote: As he shot back up into the herd, he was greeted by nothing less than the sight of a dragon tempest rupturing before him.

timeline.summary: A bell rings from a Mardu camp and an ancient dragon leads a herd of dragons up to meet Sarkhan; he sees the other timeline's rotting skull in her face.
timeline.quote: Shooting toward him was both the dragon of this now, flesh and blood and scales, and the dragon of the now that had been lost forever

timeline.summary: Sarkhan lands at the Mardu camp and is attacked by the goblin Vial Smasher, whom he knew as Ankle Shanker and who doesn't recognize him.
timeline.quote: You're here! You're alive! Just like the dragon.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan transforms to shield Vial Smasher from her own thrown vial of dragonfire.
timeline.quote: As it shattered on the ground, Sarkhan transformed into a dragon and dove in front of Vial Smasher

timeline.summary: Sarkhan meets Zurgo, now the bell-striker, who does not know Sarkhan and says no one says the word khan under Kolaghan Dragonlord.
timeline.quote: Kolaghan Dragonlord kill khan-sayers.

timeline.summary: Zurgo mocks the name Vol and raises his dull blade; Sarkhan flees into the sky, realizing no one knows him in this changed Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Both orc and goblin stood in paralyzed stillness as Sarkhan Vol launched himself into the sky.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Narset might be alive in this timeline and heads to Jeskai territory to find her.
timeline.quote: She would be here. She would be alive!

timeline.summary: Sarkhan learns that the dragon Ojutai rules the Jeskai and follows word of Narset to the Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.
timeline.quote: He followed word of her name up and up, ever closer to Ojutai's roost.

timeline.summary: Master Taigam tells Sarkhan that Narset was a heretic punished to the full extent of the law and is no more.
timeline.quote: Narset is no more.

timeline.summary: Taigam throws Sarkhan down the stairs; Sarkhan flies off in despair, resolving to wake Ugin to repair the timeline.
timeline.quote: It was time to wake the Spirit Dragon.

timeline.summary: In the looted archive beneath Dirgur, Narset reads the last scroll about the khans' summit and discovers Ojutai led the attack on them, which also reveals Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: One of those dragons had been Ojutai.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan reflects, in flight, that everyone he knew lives changed, except himself and Narset, and resolves to ask Ugin.
timeline.quote: Everyone lived, it seemed, save two. Sarkhan. And Narset.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees blue-white light rise from Ugin's canyon and is harried by ghostly dragons that then retreat.
timeline.quote: Soon the spirit was joined by others.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds the hedron cocoon crumbled and Ugin alive, projecting images of Tarkir's dragons on the canyon wall.
timeline.quote: There, at the end of the canyon, a luminous shape towered, wings outstretched.

timeline.summary: Ugin deduces from the hedron shard that it came from the Eye after his defeat, and asks who Sarkhan is.
timeline.quote: I'm applying logic.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan explains his history: Ugin's spirit whispered to him, Bolas sent him to the Eye, and he later traveled back in time to save Ugin.
timeline.quote: When I stepped through I traveled back, before the dragons died, and tipped the scales of history.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan names Bolas as the one who sent him to the Eye to release the Eldrazi, and Ugin contains him briefly in a sphere of force before releasing him.
timeline.quote: He wanted it opened, the devourers released. He never told me why.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that Sarkhan's original Tarkir never existed, and that Sarkhan never was born in this history.
timeline.quote: you, Sarkhan Vol, stepped fully formed out of a shadow, a place that never existed.

timeline.summary: Ugin recounts that Sorin Markov woke him and spoke of foolishness at the Eye.
timeline.quote: An ally of mine, a vampire and a Planeswalker, woke me up and spoke to me of 'foolishness at the Eye.'

timeline.summary: Sarkhan thanks Ugin and flies off to find Narset, certain she lives again.
timeline.quote: I say she lives again, and I will find her.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds this timeline's Narset walking through the snow; she doesn't know him but has read secret histories about the sar-khan.
timeline.quote: About a dragon-man, a sar-khan, who came from something called the Unwritten

timeline.summary: Narset reveals she traveled beyond Tarkir; Sarkhan explains planeswalkers and that three are in the valley.
timeline.quote: Planeswalker," said Sarkhan. "That's what we're called.

timeline.summary: Narset goes to speak to Ugin and plans to study Atarka's ivory histories, content to stay on Tarkir for now; Sarkhan agrees.
timeline.quote: But this world has secrets enough. For right now…I'm right where I want to be.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan arrives on Tarkir, recalls his past and the ghost of Ugin urges him to find the doorway; he sets out for the mountains.
timeline.quote: who urges him to "find the doorway."

timeline.summary: Zurgo, mad with rage after his Mardu refuse to follow his personal quest, kills the challenger and leaves alone to hunt Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: Zurgo's command is challenged, and he kills the challenger

timeline.summary: Narset leads Sarkhan to the Nexus and stays to hold off Zurgo, who kills her; Sarkhan swears vengeance and steps through the gate.
timeline.quote: Zurgo overpowers Narset, killing her.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges in Tarkir's past, sees Atarka and Yasova, and realizes he has traveled back in time.
timeline.quote: He realizes the truth: he has traveled into Tarkir's past

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Sarkhan she follows a vision given by Bolas, and Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies off.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies away.

timeline.summary: Bolas strikes down Ugin, Sarkhan wraps Ugin in a hedron cocoon, and is whisked back to an altered present; the dragon tempests intensify.
timeline.quote: Bolas strikes Ugin down as Sarkhan tumbles into the snow.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan awakens in the altered present, unable to revive Ugin, and finds Kolaghan, Vial Smasher, Zurgo and Taigam changed and not knowing him.
timeline.quote: He encounters the dragonlord Kolaghan

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds Ugin awake, learns he was never born in this timeline, and finds Narset, a Planeswalker exile; both are content to remain on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: both Planeswalkers agree that they are exactly where they wish to be.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas arranges for Sarkhan Vol, Jace and Chandra to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.
timeline.quote: the elder dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas arranged for three Planeswalkers to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.

timeline.summary: Vial Smasher spends a lifetime handling and smashing vials of dragonfire in the Kolaghan clan.
timeline.quote: she has spent a lifetime handling—and smashing—vials of this dangerous substance

timeline.summary: Yasova reveals Bolas killed Ugin and that she was used as a tool, and that hedrons cast by Sarkhan Vol preserved some essence of Ugin.
timeline.quote: That dragon, called Bolas, killed Ugin.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges at the Crucible, saying he is looking for hope in the dragonstorm and that all the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.
timeline.quote: All of the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.

timeline.summary: Elspeth easily defeats Sarkhan, and Narset blasts him when he springs up to stab Elspeth in the back.
timeline.quote: The blast sent Sarkhan crashing to the ground ten feet away, panting and boneless and stunned.

timeline.summary: Elspeth sheathes her sword and warns Sarkhan she will kill him if he attacks again.
timeline.quote: If you attack us again, I'll kill you.

timeline.summary: Wounded and humiliated, Sarkhan limps back to his hut in Mardu territory, mourning his lost power.
timeline.quote: He walked for hours from the Crucible to the cold fields of Mardu territory.

timeline.summary: Taigam introduces himself to Sarkhan, claiming to have something he wants.
timeline.quote: My name is Taigam,

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, desperate to regain his draconic form, hunts a young dragon for its heart under Taigam's direction.
timeline.quote: This is how you fly with a dragon's wings once more,

timeline.summary: Sarkhan spears the dragon and Taigam binds it with blue fire to pin it down.
timeline.quote: The blade sank through the dragon's cheek and then deeper

timeline.summary: Sarkhan cuts out the dragon's heart, chants with Taigam, senses the spell's corruption, and bites into the heart.
timeline.quote: he bit down into the organ.

timeline.summary: A wave of magic panics the herd and the Abzan dragons throw their riders as a huge red dragon rises with a flight of smaller ones.
timeline.quote: a dragon of improbable size: red-scaled, triumphant, roaring as dozens of its smaller brethren rose to join it.

timeline.summary: Ajani recognizes the giant dragon as Sarkhan in his transformed dragon form.
timeline.quote: It was Sarkhan in his dragon form.

timeline.summary: Ajani bursts into the chamber to report that Sarkhan has taken control of the wild dragons at the borders.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan Vol has taken control of the wild dragons at the borders.

timeline.summary: Narset warns that Sarkhan could bring thousands of dragons against Arashin, and the council doubts her.
timeline.quote: It will be thousands of dragons.

timeline.summary: Nur arrives and confirms that hundreds of dragons are already in Sarkhan's army.
timeline.quote: My scouts report there are already hundreds of dragons in Sarkhan's army.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, bound to the dragons by the ritual, resolves to destroy the temple that rivals his control.
timeline.quote: And the first thing he needed to do was destroy the temple.

timeline.summary: Narset climbs out and sees the sky black with dragons, and Elspeth names Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: "He's here."

timeline.summary: Elspeth challenges Sarkhan in the air and says she is not afraid of him.
timeline.quote: I am not afraid of you.

timeline.summary: Elspeth plunges toward Sarkhan's open mouth as her last stand.
timeline.quote: Elspeth pulled her wings close to her back, plummeting through the sky like a stone

timeline.summary: Elspeth is clasped in Sarkhan's jaws while Ajani appeals to him, and Narset asks about the ritual and its sacrifice.
timeline.quote: What did you cut out of yourself to corrupt the spell?

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, stung with shame, vows to bathe the Multiverse in fire and goes after Elspeth.
timeline.quote: I want to bathe the Multiverse in fire for what it has done to me.

timeline.summary: Ajani catches the falling Elspeth and says he came to fight with her in the present.
timeline.quote: To fight with you in the present.

timeline.summary: Abzan dragons suffer mounting casualties, and Narset, Ajani and Elspeth plan to blind Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: If each of us goes for one of his eyes, we might be able to blind him

timeline.summary: Ugin burns Sarkhan with ghostfire and Sarkhan dives away through the storm.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan screamed as it enveloped him.

timeline.summary: After a victory against a rival clan, a long-dead dragon's spirit whispers a spell into Sarkhan's mind and vanishes.
timeline.quote: The spirit of a long-dead dragon appeared to him, whispered a spell into his mind, and then vanished forever.

timeline.summary: A huge fire dragon bursts from Sarkhan's body and burns his men and his enemies to cinders, igniting his planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: a huge dragon made of fire streaked out of Sarkhan's body and invaded the battle

timeline.summary: Sarkhan travels from plane to plane seeking a dragon to dedicate his life to, and on Jund declares fealty to Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: There, he declared his fealty to the dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Disillusioned by Bolas, Sarkhan falls into madness and is led back to Tarkir by a voice he believes is Ugin's.
timeline.quote: Disillusioned by his servitude to the villainous, conniving, woefully undragonlike Bolas, Sarkhan fell into madness.

timeline.summary: Aided by Narset at the cost of her life, Sarkhan travels back through time to prevent Ugin's death at Bolas's hands.
timeline.quote: a way to travel back through time to the moment of Ugin's death at Nicol Bolas's hands and prevent the spirit dragon from falling.

timeline.summary: Pulled back to the present, Sarkhan finds a world ruled by dragonlords where Ugin and Narset are still alive.
timeline.quote: a world in which both Ugin and Narset were still alive.

timeline.summary: The Tarkir of Sarkhan's birth is gone, and Sarkhan is now a man never born, with his mind free of Bolas and Ugin.
timeline.quote: his mind is once again his own, free of the influences of both Bolas and Ugin.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan travels back in time more than a thousand years and saves Ugin from death, ensuring the dragon tempests and thus dragons continue.
timeline.quote: he travelled back in time more than a thousand years to a crucial turning point, and there he saved Planeswalker Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, from death.

relations.note: Sarkhan became Bolas's servant after his will was broken; Bolas dismissed him.
relations.quote: I sought his service, and he granted it.

relations.note: Sarkhan was a wing leader in the Horde.
relations.quote: I am a wing leader.

relations.note: Sarkhan fights and burns Sultai forces.
relations.quote: I charged through the confusion and cleaved the sorcerer who led them.

relations.note: Zurgo hates Vol and swears to kill him.
relations.quote: He has threatened this clan enough. He must die.

relations.note: Vol was formerly Mardu.
relations.quote: a former Mardu who burned his own clanmates with dragonfire when his spark ignited.

relations.note: Sarkhan's friend and kindred spirit, who died.
relations.quote: he's left behind Narset, his friend and kindred spirit, who perished at the hands of his enemy, Zurgo.

relations.note: Zurgo is Sarkhan's enemy.
relations.quote: his enemy, Zurgo

relations.note: Sarkhan has followed Ugin's whispers for years.
relations.quote: Sarkhan Vol has been following the voice in his head—the whispers of Ugin, the Spirit Dragon—for years now

relations.note: He was Mardu in his own time.
relations.quote: He was Mardu, out of place and time.

relations.note: He was Bolas's thrall in the past.
relations.quote: in his time as Bolas's thrall he had learned to speak it well.

relations.note: She threatens him, then they part in a clash after he learns of Bolas.
relations.quote: or I'll kill you and be on my way.

relations.note: He follows Ugin's whispers and flies to protect him.
relations.quote: Ugin was in danger.

relations.note: He saved Ugin from Bolas and encased him in stone.
relations.quote: saving Ugin from the villainous Nicol Bolas and encasing the ailing Spirit Dragon in a cocoon of stone.

relations.note: He saved Ugin from death at Bolas's hands.
relations.quote: Several years have passed since Sarkhan Vol saved Ugin from death at the hands of Nicol Bolas.

relations.note: He saved Ugin and hopes Ugin will repair things.
relations.quote: Ugin would know how to make this right.

relations.note: He saved Ugin, who now questions him.
relations.quote: You went there, traveled to Tarkir's past, and used the shard to save me.

relations.note: He wishes to be free of Bolas and make him pay.
relations.quote: To be free of him forever," said Sarkhan. "To make him pay, someday, for what he did to me.

relations.note: He hopes to be the friend of this Narset as he was of the other.
relations.quote: I am your friend—or was, and hope to be again.

relations.note: Sarkhan's hated foe.
relations.quote: Sarkhan's hated foe, Nicol Bolas

relations.note: Zurgo hates Sarkhan and Sarkhan swears vengeance in return.
relations.quote: his hated enemy, Sarkhan Vol

relations.note: Sarkhan recognizes her as his friend.
relations.quote: He recognizes her as his friend Narset

relations.note: Sarkhan is Bolas's mad minion.
relations.quote: his own mad minion Sarkhan Vol

relations.note: In another timeline he counted her a clan-mate and friend.
relations.quote: In another timeline, with another name, the Planeswalker Sarkhan Vol considered her a clan-mate and a friend.

relations.note: she knows him from before
relations.quote: It has been some time.

relations.note: attacks her and is defeated
relations.quote: Sarkhan lunged, and Elspeth met his blade in an effortless parry

relations.note: guides his ritual
relations.quote: Sarkhan had seen in Taigam a grief cousin to his own.

relations.note: formerly under Bolas's thumb
relations.quote: Like when he was under Nicol Bolas's thumb.

relations.note: commands the dragons through the ritual
relations.quote: They belonged to him.

relations.note: burns him with ghostfire
relations.quote: The ghostfire pouring out had neither color nor heat, but Sarkhan screamed as it enveloped him.

relations.note: fights her and tries to swallow her
relations.quote: I told you the last time we fought that you would die if you came after us again.

relations.note: once saved Ajani from the dragon Karrthus and counseled him
relations.quote: Sarkhan had saved him from the dragon Karrthus
gained status as a warrior in the Mardu clan

relations.note: He declared fealty to Bolas on Jund, later disillusioned.
relations.quote: There, he declared his fealty to the dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas.

relations.note: She aided him at the cost of her life.
relations.quote: aided by the Jeskai khan Narset at the cost of her life

relations.note: He saved Ugin from death.
relations.quote: he saved Planeswalker Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, from death.

pages_say.description: One of Bolas's minions, who battled Chandra at the Eye of Ugin.
A planeswalker who has also come to Tarkir seeking Ugin.
A dragon-worshipping planeswalker from Tarkir, once Bolas's servant and unwitting releaser of the Eldrazi, who returns home hearing a voice and seeking the door.
A planeswalker and former Mardu who burned his clanmates with dragonfire when his spark ignited, now hated by Zurgo and seeking the Spirit Dragon's tomb.
A dragon-obsessed planeswalker who steps through a flaming gate at Ugin's grave and arrives in Tarkir's past, grieving Narset and hearing no more of Ugin's whispers.
A planeswalker who watches the clash of Bolas and Ugin and learns that the whispers in his head were Ugin's plea.
A planeswalker and former Mardu dragon-seeker who has arrived in Tarkir's past and follows Yasova to learn more about the dragons and Ugin.
A planeswalker who altered Tarkir's fate by saving Ugin from Bolas and encasing him in stone.
The planeswalker who saved Ugin and vanished into the time streams, remembered by Yasova as the 'sar-khan'.
A planeswalker and dragon mage who returns to a new Tarkir of dragons after saving Ugin, finds no one remembers him, and learns that Narset has been killed as a heretic.
A man, a dragon, a khan named in the scroll who saved the Spirit Dragon and thereby saved Tarkir's dragons.
The planeswalker whose rival Zurgo was in another timeline.
A dragon-mage planeswalker who changed Tarkir's past, now an 'orphan of time' who learns from Ugin that his home timeline never existed and reunites with this world's Narset.
A dragon-obsessed Planeswalker born on Tarkir who travels back in time through the Nexus, saves Ugin from death and changes Tarkir's history; he was never born in the new timeline.
A planeswalker described as Bolas's mad minion, one of three who activated the Eye.
A planeswalker who in another timeline considered Vial Smasher a clan-mate and friend.
A planeswalker whose hedrons held magic that preserved some essence of Ugin.
